headline: Trump taps Texas’ top public health official as CDC chief medical officer
summary: Dr. Jennifer Shuford, Commissioner of the Texas Department of State Health Services, has been appointed Chief Medical Officer of the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention, creating a leadership vacancy in the state’s primary public health agency and shifting key public health administrative expertise from state to federal jurisdiction.

headline: Will Caron: ICE Breaker
summary: Political cartoonists covering Hawaii public affairs may visually address immigration enforcement policies and their impacts on local communities, potentially influencing political discourse regarding state government decisions on federal deportation cooperation or immigrant protections.
